_comment: Copy this file to fixel.config.json and update the values. Run `fixel init` for interactive setup.
_framework_comment: UI framework: 'mui' | 'tailwind' | 'css-modules' | 'other'. Controls which rules are injected into the AI prompt.

storybook._comment: Determines the @storybook/* adapter imported in generated story files.

figma._comment: Figma access token — MUST be an env-var reference, never a literal value.

tokens._comment: Your design-token source file and import paths.

_tokens_comment: namingConvention is a pattern string with {group}, {role}, and {state} placeholders. The default 'semantic.{group}.{role}' produces names like 'semantic.badge.bg'. Change the prefix or structure to match your token file's naming convention.

typography._comment: Typography import path used in generated test files.

scale._comment: Map every (fontSize/fontWeight) pair used in Figma to a token name + line height. Format: 'SIZE/WEIGHT' or 'SIZE/any'.

output._comment: Where fixel generate writes component files.

testing._comment: Testing framework used in generated test files.

ai._comment: AI provider config. API key is NEVER stored here — read from env.

prohibitedPatterns._comment: Add project-specific anti-patterns. These run in addition to fixel's built-ins.
prohibitedPatterns.name: no-hardcoded-zindex
prohibitedPatterns.message: Use z-index tokens from the design system instead of raw numbers.
